display.purpose: First-run heading (22px) and the mono status code in the response tile.

title.purpose: Request name, modal headings, quick-open input and status text (15px, Red Hat Display).

label.purpose: 11px uppercase section titles, method labels, chips, kbd and badges.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono for URLs, status codes, timings, variables, editors and the wordmark.

shadows.name: panel-ring
shadows.purpose: Request and response panels (ring, not a shadow).

shadows.name: selected-stripe
shadows.purpose: Active row in trees and lists.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on inputs and controls (--focus-ring).

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Menus, toasts, overflow popover, palette ghost.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Exits, hover colour changes, popover enter.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Routine state changes, modal, toast and sheet enter, Collapse.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Ceiling for layout and overlay motion. Defined; no current rule uses it.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entering motion. No bounce or elastic easing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Fewer and gentler, not none: transitions and pulses stop, spinners slow to 2.4s, overlays become 100ms linear fades, colour feedback stays.

breakpoints.name: requests-main container
breakpoints.value: max-width: 1000px (container query; request and response stack)

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.value: max-width: 1200px (runbook and flows drop a column)

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.value: max-width: 800px (runbook nav becomes a select); flows also at 1000px; first-run at 760px

components.name: Send Button
components.description: The one green control; fixed 108px wide so its label can change without a layout shift.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action button; 6px radius, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-secondary{height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--btn-border, rgba(240,246,252,.1));border-radius:6px;background:var(--btn-bg, #21262d);color:var(--text, #e6edf3);font:500 13px var(--sans, sans-serif);transition:background-color 100ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--btn-hover, #30363d);border-color:var(--border-hover, #8b949e)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent-fg, #4493f8)}

components.name: URL Bar
components.description: 40px inset field with a tinted method pill; ring turns blue on focus-within.
components.css: .ds-url{display:flex;align-items:center;height:40px;padding:5px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-inset, #010409);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #30363d);min-width:360px}.ds-url:focus-within{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #2f81f7)}.ds-url-method{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;width:92px;height:30px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--get, #3fb950) 14%,transparent);color:var(--get, #3fb950);font:700 12px var(--sans, sans-serif);letter-spacing:.04em}.ds-url-input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;padding:0 12px;color:var(--text, #e6edf3);font:13px var(--mono, monospace)}

components.name: Request Tab
components.description: 28px tab with method label; the active tab gets surface fill and a 1px ring.
components.html:
GETList users
POSTCreate user

components.name: Collection Tree Row
components.description: 28px row; active rows get hover fill and a 2px blue inset stripe.
components.html:
List users
Create user

components.name: Status Tile
components.description: Response status: mono code and display-face reason in a 12px tile tinted 10% by status.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill, 11px, 1px border; ok, bad and env variants are tints of their colours.
components.html: 3 headers Dev Prod
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border, #30363d);border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--edge-muted, #6e7681) 10%,transparent);color:var(--muted, #8d96a0);font:11px var(--sans, sans-serif)}.ds-chip.env{background:rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 56,139,253),.1);border-color:rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 56,139,253),.4);color:var(--accent-fg, #4493f8)}.ds-chip.bad{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad, #f85149) 10%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bad, #f85149) 40%,transparent);color:var(--danger, #f85149)}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Pill switch used in panels and for the Appearance setting.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;padding:2px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--bg-inset, #010409);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #30363d)}.ds-seg button{height:26px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:none;color:var(--muted, #8d96a0);font:12px var(--sans, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-seg button:hover:not(.on){color:var(--text, #e6edf3)}.ds-seg button.on{background:var(--btn-bg, #21262d);color:var(--text, #e6edf3);font-weight:600}.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent-fg, #4493f8)}

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-left floating message with an undo link; one of the few shadowed surfaces.

components.name: Flow Node
components.description: 220px canvas node; the dot and kind label take the node-type colour.
components.css: .ds-node{width:220px;padding:8px 10px 6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border, #30363d);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-soft, #161b22);color:var(--text, #e6edf3);font:12px var(--sans, sans-serif);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--shadow-xs, rgba(1,4,9,.4));--c:var(--post, #d29922)}.ds-node-kind{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c)}.ds-node-kind::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c)}.ds-node-label{margin-top:4px}

narrative.overview: A workbench you sit at for hours: tools laid out within reach, nothing shouting. The surfaces are layered tonal greys with hairline borders, the type is small and even, and colour is spent only on meaning: HTTP method, response status, pass/fail, a single blue for focus and selection, and one green for Send. The default look is GitHub's Primer dark; the light theme ("Mist") is a deliberately cool slate rather than bright white.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal layering plus 1px rings; shadows only on things that float over other content.
Two themes from one token set; a theme switch is only `data-theme` on `<html>`.
Colour is semantic. Nothing is decorative except the brand mark.
Pill shapes for state; 6 to 8px for controls; 12px for panels and dialogs.
Tabular numerals on counts and summaries.

rules.name: The Two Purples Rule
rules.body: Brand purple (`--brand` `#bc8cff`) and PATCH (`--patch` `#a371f7`) must stay visibly different and never swap roles.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue means something: method, status, brand, or the single blue for focus. A new colour needs a new meaning.

rules.name: The Mist Rule
rules.body: Light is cool slate, not white. Scrims and shadows in light are slate, not black.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: URLs, status codes, timings, variable names, counts on the rail and code are mono. Names and prose are Red Hat.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counts, tab badges, request summaries and tab groups use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A drop shadow means the element overlays other content. Panels and rows get rings, not shadows.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Rings are `box-shadow`, so hover, focus and selection never change the box size.

rules.name: The Role-Radius Rule
rules.body: Pick the radius by role from the scale. Do not invent 3, 5, 10 or 14px.

dos: Do use the tokens in `src/styles.css`; add new values to both the dark `:root` and the Mist block, and to the `prefers-color-scheme: light` twin.
Do use `--r-*` for every radius and `--fs-*` for every font size.
Do give every interactive element a visible keyboard focus state. The focus ring is a 2px `--accent-fg` ring.
Do enlarge small controls to a 24 by 24 px hit area with an `::after` overlay.

Do use `--dur-fast` (100ms) for exits and hover colour, `--dur-base` (160ms) for routine state change and enter, `--dur-slow` (280ms) at most, with `--ease-out` for enter and `--ease-in` for exit; animate only `transform` and `opacity` for overlays.
Do provide a reduced-motion rule beside any new animation: stop transitions and pulses, slow spinners to 2.4s, keep colour feedback, and turn overlay motion into a 100ms linear fade.
Do play exits for overlays with `useExitTransition` (a closing `data-state` on an inert copy) and use `Collapse` for small always-mounted content.
Do keep the brand mark at least 20px tall and the runner `--text` coloured.
Do use mono for data and tabular numerals for counts.
donts: Don't use `--brand` for HTTP PATCH, or `--patch` for brand elements.
Don't use bright white in the light theme; it is Mist slate, and its shadows and scrims are slate, not black.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing (the motion tokens forbid it).
Don't put a shadow on a resting panel or row; use a ring.
Don't use red for tab group labels; red means errors and Prod.
Don't hard-code hex in components. The only literals outside the token blocks are the select caret SVG (`#7d8590`) and the native window background in `theme.ts`.
Don't change a button's width when its label changes; Send stays 108px.
Don't use `Collapse` for long lists; its children stay mounted.
